run_GTestJsonOutputUnitTest: run the googletest JSON output unit test suite to verify gtest binary JSON output correctness
test_non_empty_json_output: test the GTestJsonOutputUnitTest.testNonEmptyJsonOutput method to verify non-empty JSON output from a gtest binary
test_empty_json_output: test the GTestJsonOutputUnitTest.testEmptyJsonOutput method to verify empty JSON output from a gtest binary with no tests
test_timestamp_value: test the GTestJsonOutputUnitTest.testTimestampValue method to validate the timestamp attribute format in JSON output
test_filtered_json_output: test the GTestJsonOutputUnitTest.testFilteredTestJsonOutput method to verify JSON output when a gtest filter is applied
